'''Jason Burrows''' was the Dagobah Regional qualifier at the [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], from Miami, Florida.<ref name="field">[https://web.archive.org/web/19991128125001/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/swworldchamp/finalists.html Finalists], Decipher (Wayback 28 November 1999)</ref>
